newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU 1997 oilseed area seen 3.2 pct up at 5.54 mln ha.
newsitem.headline: EU 1997 oilseed area seen 3.2 pct up at 5.54 mln ha.

text.p: European Union oilseed plantings for food and industrial use are expected to rise 3.2 percent to 5.54 million hectares in 1997, the EU oilseeds, animal fats and vegetable oils association (ANGO) said in a preliminary forecast on Friday.
Overall rapeseed plantings are expected to rise by 2.3 percent to 2.69 million ha and sunflowerseed plantings to increase by 2.0 percent to 2.44 million ha.

"The forecast should be treated with caution," an ANGO official told Reuters, noting that in some countries plantiings had not yet been completed and that the planting deadline for oilseeds for industrial use was May 15.
In several countries plantings may be over the limit set under the bilateral agreement with the U.S., the official said.
But the situation was uncertain because small producer plantings, which are exempted, as well as plantings for industrial use, were not yet known, the official added.
Under the 1992 Blair House agreement, EU subsidised oilseed plantings cannot exceed 5.482 million ha, less 10 percent compulsory set-aside.
Plantings for energy and other industrial uses fell nearly 33 percent to 432,000 ha, falling a halving of the set-aside rate to five percent.
